title: The evaluator's host-MCP-only flag is derived by hand at four dispatch sites with no test of the wiring
outcome: The flag that gives an acceptance-evaluator child only the host's MCP servers is derived in one place beside the Engram runtime config, and a test on a real dispatch path proves a Claude evaluator's spawn gets --strict-mcp-config.
acceptance: A test dispatches a turn for a Claude evaluator child through a production path and asserts its argv carries --strict-mcp-config; the same path for a non-evaluator does not.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
host_mcp_servers_only is computed by one locked helper that the dispatch paths in src/turn_dispatch.rs and src/session_config.rs call, not by hand at each site.
